annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 June 2023 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC and Council Directive 73/361/EEC
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC and Council Directive 73/361/EEC
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 165/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230 replaces the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC. It sets essential health and safety requirements for machinery, related products and partly completed machinery. It extends coverage to digital safety risks, including self-evolving behaviour, autonomy and cybersecurity. It requires third-party conformity assessment for machine-learning safety systems and sets out economic operators' obligations and market surveillance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces Directive 2006/42/EC with a directly applicable regulation covering machinery, related products and partly completed machinery.
Safety components include software; systems with self-evolving behaviour ensuring safety functions require third-party conformity assessment (Annex I).
Risk assessment must cover evolving behaviour and varying levels of autonomy, plus interactions in coordinated machinery.
Manufacturers must protect against malicious third-party corruption affecting safety and make source code available to authorities on request.
Substantial modification by physical or digital means triggers a new conformity assessment; Member States must set penalties.
